messages:
pagerduty-bot: 🔔 Paging oncall - private-vpc-gpu-saturation for customer Polaris Analytics in us-west2. Queue length on inference gateway > 4k, 95th token latency ~2.2s, error rate rising to 8%. Impact: some dedicated/private model endpoints returning 503/timeout. Escalation level: P1.

maria: ack — I'm on it. tagging @jon and @samir. starting triage.

maria: quick check: autoscaler reported repeated create failures for node group polaris-gpu-pool. grabbing autoscaler events now.

maria: ```
# kubectl -n kube-system logs cluster-autoscaler-0
W020 14:19:02.123 nodegroup.go:212] Failed to create instance: SubnetAllocationFailed: NoAvailableAddresses
I020 14:19:02.124 scale_up.go:98] Skipping scale-up: no capacity, subnet exhausted
```

jon: that's... the customer's VPC subnet ran out of allocatable IPs. Polices we usually recommend say /26 minimum for dedicated gpu pools, looks like they deployed /28.

samir: confirming from cloud console: polaris-prod-subnet-a remaining IPs = 0. Autoscaler keeps requesting but cloud provider rejects new NIC attachments. Also seeing several node boots stuck on image pull: "waiting for image" on our private registry mirror — spikes in pulls likely from bounce attempts.

maria: ok two blockers then: (1) subnet IP exhaustion, (2) node bootstrap/image-pull stalls delaying any capacity that might become available.

lee: @maria I'm drafting a customer message. Polaris-ops is in the thread (they DM'd pager earlier).

polaris-ops: confirming, we saw a traffic surge from a recurring job this morning, and our subnets are small by design. We can temporarily throttle that job. Also we have a mirror rate limit for signed images — might be hitting it.

maria: mitigations I'm attempting now:
- temporarily scale down non-critical dev/test nodepools in the polaris cluster to free IPs
- cordon non-essential gpu nodes and drain low-priority pods
- enable autoscaler fallback to launch smaller-gpu instance types in a different subnet as a stopgap (if available)
- open a support ticket with customer networking to expand subnet or add secondary CIDR

maria: executing drain/scale commands now: ```
# rdctl cluster scale --cluster polaris --pool nonprod-gpu --replicas 0
# kubectl cordon gpu-dev-03 && kubectl drain gpu-dev-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

samir: those helped a bit — freed ~8 IPs, autoscaler retried, but several create requests still rejected. Cloud console shows ENI attach throttling spikes. This will be slow. The image-pull rate limit is still causing some node boots to hang (~20% of boots).

jon: while we wait, I'm going to flip routing so new traffic for Polaris' high-priority endpoints goes to Hosted (redwood-hosted fallback) for a subset of routes. That should lower queue growth and customer-visible errors. Rolling change now.

jon: ```
# rdctl route update --customer polaris --route /v1/generate --fallback hosted --weight 0.6
```

lee: customer notified: sending short note "we're mitigating by draining non-critical capacity, enabling hosted fallback, and working with your networking team on subnet expansion. ETA 30-60m for steadier service."

polaris-ops: acknowledged, throttling the cron job now. We can expand subnet but it's a change request that takes 2h with our infra team.

maria: update: after freeing IPs and fallback routing, queue dropped to ~700 and error rate down to 1.8%. Latency 95th back to ~1.1s. Not fully resolved but degraded impact.

samir: opened cloud support ticket (CS-99234) for ENI attach throttling and guidance on IP exhaustion mitigation. Also filed internal ticket for image-mirror throttling (IM-459) with ops to increase mirror concurrency. ops-bot created both tickets.

ops-bot: Created ticket CS-99234 (cloud provider ENI/attach) and IM-459 (internal mirror throughput). Assigned to samir and infra.

maria: taking lead for live mitigation for next 30m, then I'll hand off to jon for follow-up. Things to do postmortem: document minimum subnet sizing for private gpu pools, add autoscaler detection for subnet exhaustion (alert earlier), add auto-fallback policy to route to hosted if queue grows >1k for >3m.

jon: ack - I'll pick up follow-ups. Pete from platform will help add the fallback policy.

lee: customer comms: will send a follow-up summary once we have stable metrics for 30m.

maria: handoff to @jon at 14:35 — I'm going offline for a meeting but will re-check in 1 hour. Leave this thread open for updates.

jon: taking over. Current state: queue 420, errors 0.9%, latency 95th 0.98s. Continuing: monitor autoscaler retries, wait for cloud ticket, coordinate with polaris to expand subnet.

polaris-ops: thanks everyone. We'll schedule CIDR expansion but appreciate the fallback. We'll follow up on image registry limits.

maria: post-incident action items (short):
- infra: add autoscaler sentinel for "SubnetAllocationFailed" to trigger preemptive alert (samir)
- platform: document & enforce recommended subnet CIDR per dedicated gpu pool (jon)
- devex: add quick runbook for enabling hosted fallback routing (lee)
- ops: increase mirror throughput, implement backoff jitter to avoid boots thundering (samir)

jon: capturing actions into INC-2795 and assigning owners. Closing live pager thread, will keep incident open for follow-up until CIFs are done.

maria: thanks team.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by maria, severity downgraded to P2 based on mitigation.

jon: closing notes: if anyone sees queue creeping up again, ping #incidents and @jon.
